messages:
jamie (product): Heads-up — Realtime Gateway v2 is GA for the hosted API. This release unifies multiplexed streaming, structured function bindings (contracts), and predictive batching to reduce tail latency and cost. Rollout begins today for us-west-1 and eu-west-1; other regions will follow next week. Docs + migration guide: https://redwood.example.com/realtime-v2-migration

oli (eng-runtime): TL;DR: new stable endpoint is /v2/realtime. It supports multiplexed sessions so clients can manage multiple logical conversations over one connection. Backcompatible with /v1/stream for basic streaming, but /v1 will be deprecated (see timeline below). To opt in for v2 features set header X-RW-Realtime: v2 and include a session_id in requests.

kevin (devex): SDK change: client.realtime.connect({version: 'v2'}) or use curl: 

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-RW-Realtime: v2" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"session_id":"abc123","model":"aeon-lite-7b"}' \
  https://api.redwood.com/v2/realtime
```

sophie (eng-sre): Monitoring/alerts: new Console dashboards for Realtime v2 are live. Default alerting thresholds: 95th latency > 500ms sustained for 3m, or error rate > 1.5%. We'll be watching for throttle spikes during the rollout window and adjust autoscale policies as needed.

deploy-bot: deploy complete — realtime-gateway-v2 service deployed at 2629990120 :white_check_mark:

zara (docs): Migration checklist uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/docs/realtime-v2-migrate. It includes code snippets, SDK examples, and a compatibility table. Please open PRs on docs if you spot missing examples.

mike (eng-runtime): New models available on v2 at GA: aeon-lite-7b (stream-optimized, low cost), aeon-pro-13b (balanced throughput), monolith-13b-quant (fast-quant variant). Note: monolith-13b-quant uses a slightly different tokenization mapping — run your evals before switching production workloads.

jamie (product): Deprecation plan: we turned off new signups to /v1/stream today for Hosted; full sunset of /v1/stream is scheduled for 2026-09-30. We will provide a compatibility shim for common patterns but please migrate to /v2/realtime to use multiplexing and predictive batching. If your team needs an extended window, file an eng-runtime migration request.

lia (engineer): quick question — will the function binding contract changes require schema version bumps in our backends?

oli (eng-runtime): short answer: yes — function bindings now require an explicit "contract" object in the session create call. We added a validate_contract CLI tool in CLI v0.9.2 to lint contracts locally. See the migration guide for examples.

emily (customer-success): FYI i'm prepping customer comms for Dedicated and Private customers who may need hands-on support during migration. Can engineering share a short list of breaking changes?

kevin (devex): note — embeddings and existing generation REST endpoints are unaffected. This rollout is realtime/generation streaming only.

jamie (product): Thanks all — we'll post a shorter public GA blurb in #general and schedule open office hours tomorrow 10:00am PT in #devex for live migration help. :rocket:
